tier_should.rationale: Shows scientists value reviewer-score variance via a large DCE, challenging mean-only aggregation. Credible design but hypothetical choices, selection bias, and external validity concerns remain. Strong fit for innovation, science-policy, or management journals.

tier_will.rationale: Prominent authors and timely science-funding topic favor strong placement; likely top field outlet (e.g., Management Science or Research Policy). Method and external-validity limits make top-five general journals unlikely.
